answer: Random beacon checks plus a compute heartbeat stop fake identities before they reach their zenith. Each agent posts a $25 bond, then answers beacon challenges and a heartbeat proving live work; a jetty checkpoint admits only agents whose jobs verify. Miss two checks and the bond burns. Creating 1,000 fakes costs $25,000 plus 10,000 forged jobs, while a comet-fast attacker cannot fake proof. One honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
